Delicious Rawa Fried Prawns
By: ravikumar
Published: Friday, January 12, 2018 - 1:34am

Ingredients




Oil
Coriander seeds
Dried red chilies
Curry leaves
Scraped coconut
Prawns
Lemon juice
Salt
Turmeric powder
Chili powder
Rava
Rice flour
Water

Preparation

1 Here, Roopa shows you a prawns preparation from a coastal region, Karwar. 2 Method: 3 1. In a heated pan, add in oil, coriander seeds, dried red chilies, curry leaves and scraped coconut. 4 2. Roat all these ingredients until the coconut is light brown in colour. 5 3. Add this to a blender along with some water and blend it into a fine paste. 6 4. In a bowl, add in the prawns, lemon juice, salt, turmeric powder, chili powder and the paste. 7 5. Mix well and let it sit for a while. 8 6. Coat the prawns with rava and rice flour and deep fry them. 9 7. Garnish and serve.

About

Make a Delicious Rawa Fried Prawns at home with hilarious Herbs and species which give the authentic taste to Home Made Prawns Fry Recipes and make it more Mouthwatering. The Recipe for Delicious Rawa Fried Prawns is quick and easy to make at home. It can be served as snacks, side dish or even in Main meal courses. It the best food for the house party as the starter.
